A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.title: A03 "Red Alert" Sniper Rifle
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.lead: The A03 "Red Alert" Sniper Rifle is a sniper rifle manufactured by Gemini .
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.desc: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.desc_ko: A03 저격소총으로 먼 거리에서 적을 쓸어버리세요. Gemini의 테바린 공동 창업자 클렘이 정교하게 설계한 이 총은 세련되고 인체공학적인 디자인과 강력한 탄도 위력을 겸비했습니다. 연속 사격이 필요할 때 정확도보다 속도를 택해, 저격소총치고 인상적인 연사력을 보여 줍니다. 이름난 디자인과 독특한 특징 덕분에 제국 전역의 보안 전문가들이 아끼는 총이 된 것도 당연합니다. 'Red Alert' 에디션은 회색과 강렬한 빨강을 섞어 대담하고 역동적인 디자인을 완성했습니다.

A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap).title: A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap)
A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap).subtitle: Magazine
A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap).lead: The A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap) is a magazine that loads 7mm rounds into the A03 Sniper Rifle . It is manufactured by Gemini .
A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap).desc: This magazine for the Gemini A03 sniper rifle holds fifteen 7mm rounds.
A03 Sniper Rifle Magazine (15 cap).desc_ko: Gemini A03 저격소총용 탄창으로, 7mm 탄 15발이 들어갑니다.

ASD Secure Drive.title: ASD Secure Drive
ASD Secure Drive.subtitle: Device
ASD Secure Drive.lead: The ASD Secure Drive is a reward obtained from investigation contracts that take place in the ASD Onyx Facility . Wikelo offers collection contracts to trade in ASD Secure Drives.
ASD Secure Drive.desc: An ASD Onyx Facility data drive made to securely store propriety information.
ASD Secure Drive.lead_ko: ASD 오닉스 시설에서 진행하는 조사 계약의 보상으로 얻는 보안 드라이브. 위켈로가 이 드라이브를 받는 수집 계약을 제공합니다.
ASD Secure Drive.desc_ko: 독점 정보를 안전하게 보관하도록 만든 ASD 오닉스 시설의 데이터 드라이브.

ATLS Cool Metal Color.title: ATLS Cool Metal Color
ATLS Cool Metal Color.subtitle: Collection

ATLS Cool Metal Color.desc: Wikelo give deep red and green colors to make ATLS legs look like they cooling from heat. Very pretty.
ATLS Cool Metal Color.lead_ko: 위켈로가 제공하는 ATLS 도색 수집 계약 (Cool Metal).
ATLS Cool Metal Color.desc_ko: 위켈로가 짙은 빨강이랑 초록 색 줌. ATLS 다리가 뜨거운 데서 식는 것처럼 보이게. 아주 예쁨.

ATLS Orange Line.title: ATLS Orange Line
ATLS Orange Line.subtitle: Collection

ATLS Snowland Color.subtitle: Collection

Ace Interceptor Helmet.title: Ace Interceptor Helmet
Ace Interceptor Helmet.subtitle: Helmet
Ace Interceptor Helmet.lead: The Ace Interceptor Helmet is a helmet manufactured by Basilisk .
Ace Interceptor Helmet.desc: The unique open-faced design makes the Ace Interceptor helmet a lightweight and liberating option for operating in atmosphere. It features precisely layered plating to protect the head from a variety of combat and environmental hazards and an impact resistant, anti-glare visor over the eyes. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.
Ace Interceptor Helmet.desc_ko: 독특한 오픈 페이스 디자인 덕분에 Ace Interceptor 헬멧은 대기권에서 가볍고 자유롭게 활동할 수 있는 선택지입니다. 정밀하게 겹친 장갑판이 다양한 전투·환경 위험으로부터 머리를 보호하고, 눈 부분에는 충격에 강한 눈부심 방지 바이저가 있습니다. 바이저는 AR 조준선을 지원합니다.

Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.title: Idris-P
Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Aegis Dynamics
Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.lead: The Idris-P (Peacekeeper) is a variant of the Idris frigate developed by Aegis Dynamics . This vessel is specifically tailored for civilian use, having had all military-grade equipment removed. Featuring two hangars capable of housing three small vessels and one snub craft, along with enhanced cargo capacity and numerous gun turrets, it serves as an optimal choice for militia, corporate, and private entities in various different roles.
Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Aegis Dynamics의 아이드리스 프리깃 민간형(Idris-P, 피스키퍼). 군용 장비를 걷어 내고 민간용으로 맞춘 함선이며, 소형 함선을 실을 수 있는 격납고 두 곳을 갖췄습니다. 위켈로가 손본 'War Special' 버전.

Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.title: Sabre Firebird
Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Aegis Dynamics
Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.lead: The Sabre Firebird is a medium fighter belonging to the Sabre series, developed by Aegis Dynamics . Designed for swift and relentless assaults using its customized missile system, this high-velocity combat aircraft excels in launching rapid barrages. Its primary objective is to neutralize potential dangers swiftly, leaving adversaries with minimal time to respond. This versatile fighter is equally proficient in embarking on extended-range missions or swiftly mobilizing to safeguard your operational headquarters.
Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.key: Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special
Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Aegis Dynamics의 Sabre 계열 중형 전투기. 개조된 미사일 시스템으로 빠르고 집요한 공격에 특화돼 있습니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Spec.title: Sabre Peregrine
Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Spec.subtitle: Aegis Dynamics
Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Spec.lead: The Sabre Peregrine is a medium racing ship manufactured by Aegis Dynamics . The Peregrine represents the pinnacle of speed among Sabre models, utilizing the renowned military-derived Sabre chassis and refining it for unparalleled velocity. This already aerodynamic structure is enhanced by custom thrusters and meticulously optimized engines, propelling the Peregrine's straight-line speed into an entirely new category.
Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Spec.key: Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Special
Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Spec.lead_ko: Aegis Dynamics의 중형 레이싱 함선. Sabre 계열 중 가장 빠른 모델입니다. 위켈로 'Speedy Special' 버전.

Antium Arms.title: Antium Armor Arms
Antium Arms.subtitle: Arm armor
Antium Arms.lead: The Antium Armor Arms is the heavy arms of the Antium armor set, manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Antium Arms.desc: If you're in need of top-of-the-line protection enhanced with bleeding-edge technology, look no further than the Antium Armor Set. Developed by the award-winning engineering team at Quirinus Tech, the suit is fully enclosed to protect its wearer against hazardous environments and the dangers of the battlefield. Instead of a traditional laminate faceplate, the helmet utilizes a suite of sensors to create an uncompromised field of vision.
Antium Arms.lead_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Antium 방어구 세트 중 중장갑 팔 부위.
Antium Arms.desc_ko: 최첨단 기술로 강화된 최고급 보호 장비가 필요하다면 Antium 방어구 세트가 정답입니다. 수상 경력에 빛나는 Quirinus Tech 엔지니어링 팀이 개발한 이 슈트는 완전 밀폐형으로, 착용자를 위험한 환경과 전장의 위협으로부터 보호합니다. 헬멧은 일반적인 적층 안면판 대신 여러 센서를 사용해 시야를 전혀 가리지 않습니다.

Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.lead: The F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II is a medium sized fighter variant of the F7C Hornet Mk II , developed by Anvil Aerospace . Anvil has enhanced their esteemed military-class superiority fighter by integrating the latest technological advancements, resulting in the F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II. This variant preserves the dual cockpit and ball turret features that contributed to the formidable reputation of its predecessor in combat scenarios.
Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.lead_ko: Anvil Aerospace F7C Hornet Mk II의 중형 전투기 변형 F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II. 군용 제공 전투기에 최신 기술을 더했습니다. 위켈로 버전.

Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.title: F8C Lightning
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The Anvil Aerospace F8C Lightning is the civilian variant of the F8A Lightning space superiority fighter that is used by the United Empire of Earth Navy . It closely mimics the military specs of the original F8A, and has been used in lines of defense against Vanduul invaders. It was made available in extremely limited numbers to the civilian market by Anvil to celebrate the debut of the F8A in the UEE Navy.
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.key: Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.lead_ko: UEE 해군 제공 전투기 F8A Lightning의 민간형. 원형의 군용 사양을 거의 그대로 따릅니다. 위켈로 'Sneak Special' 버전.

Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.title: Terrapin Medic
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.lead: The Terrapin Medic is a medical support vessel designed by Anvil Aerospace . Featuring a tier 2 medical bed, this ship is adept at securely extracting injured persons from hazardous situations, thanks to its durable armor and shielding systems. Functioning as both a compact frontline trauma center and a resilient search and rescue craft, the Terrapin Medic and its crew are dedicated to preserving lives and ensuring operational continuity in the most challenging environments and circumstances.
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.key: Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Special
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.lead_ko: Anvil Aerospace의 의료 지원 함선. 2단계 의료 침대와 튼튼한 장갑·실드로 위험 지역에서 부상자를 안전하게 구출합니다. 위켈로 'Savior Special' 버전.

Argo ATLS.title: ATLS
Argo ATLS.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo ATLS.lead: The ATLS ( Assisted Transport and Loading System ) is a power suit manufactured by Argo Astronautics . It is designed to assist individuals in lifting heavy loads when manual handling poses safety risks and the use of a vehicle is not feasible. This durable exo-frame incorporates a patented structural support mechanism along with a custom tractor system, which greatly enhances the user's strength, stability, and load-bearing capabilities.
Argo ATLS.lead_ko: Argo Astronautics의 파워 슈트 ATLS(Assisted Transport and Loading System). 사람이 직접 들기 위험한 무거운 짐을 옮기도록 돕습니다.

Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.title: ATLS GEO IKTI
Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.lead: The ATLS GEO IKTI ( Banu : ikti ( ikti ) ; literally Weapon; ) is a combat retrofit of the Argo Astronautics ATLS GEO power suit developed by Wikelo Emporium .
Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.lead_ko: 위켈로 엠포리엄이 Argo ATLS GEO 파워 슈트를 전투용으로 개조한 버전. 'IKTI'는 바누어로 '무기'라는 뜻입니다.

Argo ATLS IKTI.title: ATLS IKTI
Argo ATLS IKTI.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo ATLS IKTI.lead: The ATLS IKTI ( Banu : ikti ( ikti ) ; literally Weapon; ) is a combat retrofit of the Argo Astronautics ATLS power suit performed by Wikelo Emporium .

Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.title: RAFT
Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.lead: The RAFT (Reinforced Advanced Freight Transport) is a medium cargo hauler developed by Argo Astronautics . This compact vehicle is designed to transport six standardized 32 SCU cargo containers , maximizing payload capacity and minimizing complications. Eliminate the hassle of hand-loading crates; the RAFT allows for efficient loading and unloading, preparing you for your next task. With reinforced shields, a robust weapons system, and a wide range of countermeasures, the RAFT ensures secure delivery of your cargo.
Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: Argo Astronautics의 중형 화물선 RAFT. 32 SCU 표준 화물 컨테이너 6개를 실을 수 있습니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

BUL-H4 Armor.title: BUL-H4 Armor
BUL-H4 Armor.subtitle: Undersuit
BUL-H4 Armor.lead: The BUL-H4 Armor is a super heavy armor suit manufactured by Clark Defense Systems ; its synthetic polymer plating absorbs impacts while a power-assisted frame carries the weight.
BUL-H4 Armor.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.
BUL-H4 Armor.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 초중량 방어구 슈트. 합성 폴리머 장갑이 충격을 흡수하고, 동력 보조 프레임이 무게를 받쳐 줍니다.
BUL-H4 Armor.desc_ko: BUL-H4 시리즈로 개인 보호의 기준을 새로 쓰세요. 첨단 합성 폴리머가 충격을 크게 줄여 착용자를 든든한 방벽으로 만들어 줍니다. 동력 보조 프레임이 무거운 슈트의 무게를 상쇄해 기동성을 유지해 줍니다.

BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.title: BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.subtitle: Undersuit
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.lead: The BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo is the Snow Camo edition of the BUL-H4 Armor , a super heavy armor suit manufactured by Clark Defense Systems , in a white digital camo pattern for frozen environments.
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit. Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 초중량 방어구 BUL-H4의 설상 위장(Snow Camo) 에디션. 추운 환경에 맞춘 흰색 디지털 위장 무늬입니다.
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.desc_ko: BUL-H4 시리즈로 개인 보호의 기준을 새로 쓰세요. 첨단 합성 폴리머가 충격을 크게 줄여 착용자를 든든한 방벽으로 만들어 줍니다. 동력 보조 프레임이 무거운 슈트의 무게를 상쇄해 기동성을 유지해 줍니다. 흰색 디지털 위장 무늬의 Snow Camo 에디션은 얼어붙은 환경에서 사냥감을 쫓기에 제격입니다.

BUL-H4 Helmet.title: BUL-H4 Helmet
BUL-H4 Helmet.subtitle: Helmet
BUL-H4 Helmet.lead: The BUL-H4 Helmet is the helmet of the BUL-H4 super heavy armor , manufactured by Clark Defense Systems ; its quad-visor slots feed a single combined image through CDS's PROWL hardware.
BUL-H4 Helmet.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety.
BUL-H4 Helmet.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 초중량 방어구 BUL-H4의 헬멧. 네 개의 바이저 슬롯 영상을 CDS PROWL 장치가 하나로 합쳐 보여 줍니다.
BUL-H4 Helmet.desc_ko: BUL-H4 시리즈로 개인 보호의 기준을 새로 쓰세요. CDS의 독자적인 PROWL 장치가 네 개의 바이저 슬롯 영상을 하나로 합쳐, 안전은 그대로 지키면서 막힘없는 시야를 제공합니다.

BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo.title: BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo
BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo.subtitle: Helmet
BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo.lead: The BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo is the Snow Camo edition of the BUL-H4 Helmet , in a white digital camo pattern for frozen environments, manufactured by Clark Defense Systems .
BUL-H4 Helmet Snow Camo.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety. Berry Blend Smoothie.title: Berry Blend Smoothie
Berry Blend Smoothie.subtitle: Drink
Berry Blend Smoothie.lead: The Berry Blend Smoothie is a drink available in the Star Citizen universe, sold as a fruity blended beverage that helps restore the player's thirst .
Berry Blend Smoothie.desc: A smoothie made with a fresh blend of berries.
Berry Blend Smoothie.lead_ko: 베리를 갈아 만든 음료. 마시면 갈증이 회복됩니다.

Bluemoon Fungus.title: Bluemoon Fungus
Bluemoon Fungus.subtitle: Organic
Bluemoon Fungus.lead: Bluemoon Fungus is an organic commodity harvested across the 'verse.
Bluemoon Fungus.desc: Preferring to spore in the depths of dark caves, the fruiting mushrooms of the Bluemoon fungus are often collected as a highly-valued petroleum-free lubricant used across a wide-variety of industries.
Bluemoon Fungus.lead_ko: 우주 곳곳에서 채집할 수 있는 유기물 원자재(버섯).
Bluemoon Fungus.desc_ko: 어두운 동굴 깊은 곳에서 포자를 퍼뜨리는 블루문 균류의 버섯은, 여러 산업에서 귀하게 쓰이는 석유 없는 윤활제로 자주 채집됩니다.

Bokto Arms.title: Bokto Arms
Bokto Arms.subtitle: Arm armor
Bokto Arms.lead: The Bokto Arms is an arms armor manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Bokto Arms.desc: This Antium Armor was modified from its original version. Carefully-selected fangs and bones were mounted to the set to give it a primal look.
Bokto Arms.desc_ko: 원래 버전을 개조한 Antium 방어구. 엄선한 송곳니와 뼈를 달아 원시적인 느낌을 냈습니다.

Bokto Core.title: Bokto Core
Bokto Core.subtitle: Torso armor
Bokto Core.lead: The Bokto Core is the core of the Bokto armor set, manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Bokto Core.desc: This Antium Armor was modified from its original version. Carefully-selected fangs and bones were mounted to the set to give it a primal look.
Bokto Core.lead_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Bokto 방어구 세트 중 코어.
Bokto Core.desc_ko: 원래 버전을 개조한 Antium 방어구. 엄선한 송곳니와 뼈를 달아 원시적인 느낌을 냈습니다.

Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.title: Boomtube "Clanguard" Rocket Launcher
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.subtitle: Personal weapon
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.lead: The Boomtube "Clanguard" Rocket Launcher is a scrap rocket launcher modifed with Vanduul plating by Wikelo .
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.desc: Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best. The Clanguard version has been modified with Vanduul materials and alien artifacts.
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.lead_ko: 위켈로가 반두르 장갑판으로 개조한 고물 로켓 발사기 Boomtube.
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.desc_ko: 조준할 시간이 어디 있어요? 무장 거리만 확보되면 마음에 안 드는 쪽으로 Boomtube 발사기를 겨누고 방아쇠를 당긴 다음, 수류탄 세 개짜리 로켓이 알아서 처리하는 걸 지켜보세요. 때로는 단순한 게 최고입니다. Clanguard 버전은 반두르 재료와 외계 유물로 개조했습니다.

Boomtube Rocket.title: Boomtube Rocket
Boomtube Rocket.subtitle: Magazine
Boomtube Rocket.lead: The Boomtube Rocket is a magazine for the Boomtube launcher, essentially three grenades strapped together as a single improvised round. Its manufacturer is Unknown .
Boomtube Rocket.desc: Made for the Boomtube launcher, this "rocket" is pretty much three grenades strapped together. Good luck!
Boomtube Rocket.lead_ko: Boomtube 발사기용 탄. 수류탄 세 개를 묶어 만든 즉석 로켓입니다.
Boomtube Rocket.desc_ko: Boomtube 발사기용으로 만든 이 '로켓'은 사실상 수류탄 세 개를 묶어 놓은 것입니다. 행운을 빕니다!

Boomtube Rocket Launcher.title: Boomtube Rocket Launcher
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.subtitle: Personal weapon
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.lead: The "Boomtube" is a scrap rocket launcher sold by Grey's Market . The "warhead" consists of three grenades strapped to a rocket, has a minimum arming distance, high "spread", and is difficult to aim.
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.desc: Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.lead_ko: Grey's Market에서 파는 고물 로켓 발사기. 로켓에 수류탄 세 개를 묶은 탄두를 쓰며, 최소 무장 거리가 있고 탄이 넓게 퍼져 조준이 어렵습니다.
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.desc_ko: 조준할 시간이 어디 있어요? 무장 거리만 확보되면 마음에 안 드는 쪽으로 Boomtube 발사기를 겨누고 방아쇠를 당긴 다음, 수류탄 세 개짜리 로켓이 알아서 처리하는 걸 지켜보세요. 때로는 단순한 게 최고입니다.

Carinite.title: Carinite
Carinite.subtitle: Mineral
Carinite.lead: Carinite is a deep-red-colored harvestable mineral found only on Aberdeen and Daymar . Carinite is a common requirement for collection missions.
Carinite.desc: A rare mineral because the extreme pressure needed for its formation is very uncommon, it is in high demand thanks to its use in advanced computer processors and other cutting-edge electronics.

Carinite.lead_ko: 애버딘(Aberdeen)과 데이마(Daymar)에서만 나는 짙은 붉은색 광물. 수집 계약에서 자주 요구됩니다.
Carinite.desc_ko: 형성에 필요한 극한의 압력이 매우 드물어 희귀한 광물입니다. 첨단 컴퓨터 프로세서와 최신 전자 기기에 쓰여 수요가 높습니다.

Carinite (Pure).title: Carinite (Pure)
Carinite (Pure).subtitle: Mineral
Carinite (Pure).lead: Carinite (Pure) is a deep-red-colored harvestable mineral found only on Aberdeen and Daymar . This pure vein is more rare and valuable.
Carinite (Pure).desc: Typical carinite sources feature various impurities. However, under certain extremely rare conditions, carinite veins that are more than 90% pure can form. Computing hardware that demands exacting precision will usually seek out pure carinite.

head: System
Planet/ Moon
rows: Aberdeen and Daymar , caves exposed by the hathor orbital laser platforms (rare chance of spawning)

Carinite (Pure).lead_ko: 애버딘과 데이마에서만 나는 카리나이트의 순수 광맥. 일반 카리나이트보다 드물고 값어치가 높습니다.
Carinite (Pure).desc_ko: 보통 카리나이트는 여러 불순물을 포함합니다. 하지만 극히 드문 조건에서는 순도 90%가 넘는 광맥이 생기기도 합니다. 높은 정밀도가 필요한 컴퓨팅 장비는 주로 순수 카리나이트를 찾습니다.

Citrus Beef Burrito.title: Citrus Beef Burrito
Citrus Beef Burrito.subtitle: Food
Citrus Beef Burrito.lead: Citrus Beef Burrito is a food item with a citrus-seasoned beef filling, available as a consumable that restores a small amount of hunger.
Citrus Beef Burrito.desc: This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with tangy shredded beef.
Citrus Beef Burrito.lead_ko: 시트러스 양념 소고기를 넣은 부리토. 허기를 조금 회복합니다.
Citrus Beef Burrito.desc_ko: 새콤한 찢은 소고기를 토르티야에 가득 채운 든든한 부리토.

Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.title: Coda "Ascension" Pistol
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.subtitle: Personal weapon
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.lead: The Coda "Ascension" Pistol is a pistol manufactured by Kastak Arms . The Ascension edition of the Coda Pistol has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen .
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.desc: Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single .50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.lead_ko: Kastak Arms의 권총 Coda의 Ascension 에디션. Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.desc_ko: Kastak Arms의 '핸드 캐논'이라고도 불리는 Coda는 .50구경 한 발로 교전을 끝낼 수 있지만, 위력이 큰 만큼 반동을 다루기 어렵습니다. 탄창이 작고 반동이 세서 연사보다는 정확한 단발 사격을 권합니다. IAE 2953을 기념해 디자인된 Ascension 에디션에는 Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.

Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).title: Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap)
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).subtitle: Magazine
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).lead: The Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap) is a magazine for the Coda Pistol , holding .50 caliber rounds. It is manufactured by Kastak Arms .
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).desc: This magazine for the Kastak Arms Coda holds six .50 caliber rounds.
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).desc_ko: Kastak Arms Coda용 탄창으로, .50구경 탄 6발이 들어갑니다.

Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.lead: The A2 Hercules Starlifter is a military heavy gunship and bomber developed by Crusader Industries . The A2 gunship has been used to devastating effect in airborne assaults, search and rescue operations, and landing initiatives. With more than double the firepower of the M2, and a custom bomb bay capable of delivering a staggering payload, the A2 caters to anyone hauling massive amounts of cargo through potentially unfriendly skies.

Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.lead: The Ares Star Fighter Inferno , produced by Crusader Industries , is an anti-capital fighter equipped with a Behring manufactured Size 7 ballistic gatling. Its sustained fire capability is devastating, overpowering adversaries with a relentless barrage that can take down smaller vessels and rapidly shred the hulls of larger ones. While formidable on its own, the Inferno is an effective complement to the Ares Ion in capital ship engagements, as its armor-piercing rounds can be paired with the Ion's shield-disabling shots. This combination enhances the Inferno's effectiveness in hunting down capital ships.

Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.lead: The Ares Star Fighter Ion is an anti-capital fighter manufactured by Crusader Industries . Designed to lead the charge against capital ships and heavily armed flotillas, the Ares ION excels at spearheading a fleet of fighters and support ships. Its purpose-built Behring SF7E laser cannon accurately delivers high-powered shots to quickly disable the shields of gunships and, with the support of other Ares variants, efficiently incapacitate capital-class vessels.

Crusader C1 Spirit Wikelo Special.title: C1 Spirit
Crusader C1 Spirit Wikelo Special.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader C1 Spirit Wikelo Special.lead: The C1 Spirit is a medium-size hauler developed by Crusader Industries . It serves as an essential logistical asset for any operation, facilitating the transportation of critical supplies and the delivery of ground exploration vehicles. Its spacious cargo capacity, combined with the renowned Crusader design, positions it as the optimal choice for pilots aiming to transport substantial loads while maintaining ease of use. Featuring an ample cargo hold and a rail-mounted tractor beam, the C1 Spirit serves as a versatile and adaptable vessel for Citizens navigating the 'verse on a regular basis.

Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.title: Fresnel "Deepwater" Energy LMG

Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.desc: The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management. The Deepwater edition combines a weathered blue with profound black features.

Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.lead: The Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition is the arms armor of the Geist armor set, manufactured by Kilgore and Poole .
Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.desc: An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them undetectable via radar, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps. The ASD Edition features a hooded cloak printed with a dark urban camo pattern alongside ASD's signature logo.

Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Juvenile).desc_ko: 발라카는 평생 이빨이 계속 빠지고 새로 납니다. 모래 속을 파고들며 먹이를 잡는 동안 이빨이 자주 상하기 때문이죠. 새 이빨이 다 자라면 옛 이빨을 붙잡던 결합 조직이 끊어져 땅에 떨어집니다. 발라카가 죽은 뒤 입에서 뽑아낼 수도 있습니다. 이 송곳니는 오랫동안 방사능에 노출되어 특이한 색을 띠게 되었습니다.

Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).title: Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA)
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).subtitle: Misc item
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).lead: The Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA) is a pearl from an Irradiated Valakkar .
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).desc: The valakkar pearl is harvested from the skin of the valakkar. As the valakkar moves through its environment, a large piece of grit will sometimes penetrate its thick hide. If the grit is unable to be expelled on its own, the valakkar's skin will grow to encase it. Layers of organic matter will then coat the piece of grit, isolating it from the valakkar's vulnerable dermis, thus ensuring that it will not cause infection. These "pearls" can become substantial in size over time. Because the valakkar that grew this pearl was exposed to radiation over a long period of time, it has developed unusual properties.
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).lead_ko: 방사능에 오염된 발라카에게서 얻는 진주 (AA 등급).
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).desc_ko: 발라카 진주는 발라카의 피부에서 얻습니다. 발라카가 돌아다니다 보면 큰 모래알이 두꺼운 가죽을 뚫고 들어가기도 하는데, 스스로 빼내지 못하면 피부가 자라 그것을 감쌉니다. 그 위로 유기물이 층층이 쌓여 연약한 진피와 격리되므로 감염이 일어나지 않습니다. 이 '진주'는 시간이 지나며 꽤 커질 수 있습니다. 이 진주를 키운 발라카는 오랫동안 방사능에 노출되어, 진주도 특이한 성질을 띠게 되었습니다.

Jaclium (Ore).title: Jaclium (Ore)
Jaclium (Ore).subtitle: Unrefined ores
Jaclium (Ore).lead: Jaclium (Ore) is a rare metal ore, a naturally occurring form of jahlium used to produce extremely strong, high-tensile alloys.
Jaclium (Ore).desc: A naturally occurring rare metal form of jahlium, it is used in the production of extremely strong alloys with incredible tensile strength. Originally confused with common jahlium when first discovered, the above average results when used lead to researchers to realize its value.
Jaclium (Ore).lead_ko: 희귀 금속 광석. 아주 강하고 인장력 높은 합금을 만드는 데 쓰입니다.
Jaclium (Ore).desc_ko: 자연적으로 생기는 희귀한 금속 형태의 잘리움으로, 인장 강도가 엄청난 초강력 합금을 만드는 데 쓰입니다. 처음 발견됐을 때는 일반 잘리움으로 오해받았지만, 써 보니 평균 이상의 결과가 나와 연구자들이 그 가치를 알아보게 되었습니다.

Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.title: Karna "Ascension" Rifle
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.lead: The Karna "Ascension" Rifle is an assault rifle manufactured by Kastak Arms . The Ascension edition of the Karna rifle has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen .
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.desc: The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.lead_ko: Kastak Arms의 돌격소총 Karna의 Ascension 에디션. Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.desc_ko: Karna는 Kastak Arms의 대표적인 플라즈마 돌격소총입니다. 중거리에서 위력을 발휘하며, 충전 사격과 완전 자동 사격 모드로 상황에 맞게 빠르게 전환할 수 있습니다. 이름난 화력에 더해 투박한 외형과 신뢰성 덕분에 Kastak Arms에서 가장 인기 있는 무기 중 하나입니다. IAE 2953을 기념해 디자인된 Ascension 에디션에는 Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.

Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).title: Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap)
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).subtitle: Magazine
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).lead: The Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap) is a replacement magazine manufactured by Kastak Arms for its Karna plasma assault rifle.
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).desc: This is a replacement battery for Kastak Arms' plasma assault rifle, the Karna.
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).lead_ko: Kastak Arms Karna 플라즈마 돌격소총용 교체 탄창.
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).desc_ko: Kastak Arms 플라즈마 돌격소총 Karna용 교체 배터리.

Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.title: Killshot "Dominion Camo" Rifle
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.lead: The Killshot "Dominion Camo" Rifle is an assault rifle .
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.desc: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Dominion Camo edition adds a dark green camo pattern to the rifle.
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.desc_ko: 아름다움은 보는 사람 눈에 달렸고, 제대로 겨누면 Killshot 돌격소총의 탄도 그 눈에 박힐 겁니다. 우아함은 부족해도 이 클래식한 디자인엔 거친 매력이 있습니다. Dominion Camo 에디션은 소총에 짙은 초록 위장 무늬를 더했습니다.

Killshot Rifle.title: Killshot Rifle
Killshot Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Killshot Rifle.lead: The Killshot Rifle is a twin ballistic-energy linked weapon sold by Grey's Market . The rifle fires in alternating ballistic and energy projectiles.
Killshot Rifle.desc: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm.
Killshot Rifle.lead_ko: Grey's Market에서 파는 탄도·에너지 연동 쌍열 소총. 탄도탄과 에너지탄을 번갈아 발사합니다.
Killshot Rifle.desc_ko: 아름다움은 보는 사람 눈에 달렸고, 제대로 겨누면 Killshot 돌격소총의 탄도 그 눈에 박힐 겁니다. 우아함은 부족해도 이 클래식한 디자인엔 거친 매력이 있습니다.

Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).title: Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap)
Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).subtitle: Magazine
Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).lead: The Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap) is a magazine for the Killshot Rifle , supplied pre-loaded with rounds.
Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).desc: This magazine for the Killshot rifle comes pre-loaded with forty-five rounds.
Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).desc_ko: Killshot 소총용 탄창으로, 45발이 장전된 상태로 제공됩니다.

Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.title: L-21 Wolf
Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Kruger Intergalactic
Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The L-21 Wolf is a small light Fighter developed by Kruger Intergalactic . It illustrates a combination of swiftness, grace, and an extraordinarily precise design. This vessel not only represents Kruger's inaugural independently produced ship and showcases their expertise, but it is also thoroughly outfitted for warfare, able to function autonomously or in coordination with others, armed with an impressive array of armaments.
Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.key: Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special
Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.lead_ko: Kruger Intergalactic의 소형 경전투기. 빠르고 우아하며 매우 정밀하게 설계됐습니다. 위켈로 'Sneak Special' 버전.

Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Specia.title: L-22 Alpha Wolf
Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Specia.subtitle: Kruger Intergalactic
Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Specia.lead: The L-22 Alpha Wolf is a small light Fighter manufactured by Kruger Intergalactic . Merging speed, elegance, and an exceptionally accurate design, the Alpha Wolf serves as a demonstration for Kruger while also being fully equipped for combat, capable of hunting solo or in groups with a formidable selection of weaponry.
Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Specia.key: Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Special
Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Specia.lead_ko: Kruger Intergalactic의 소형 경전투기 L-22 Alpha Wolf. 속도와 정밀함을 갖춘 Kruger의 시연 기체이자 완전 무장 전투기입니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).title: Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine)
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).subtitle: Misc item
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).lead: The Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine) is a tradable item found within the Warehouse section of the QV Station in Nyx .
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).desc: A large artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Though broken, it's otherwise considered in pristine condition. The fragment features intricate etchings that subtly glow green and is overlaid with gold-colored metallic banding.
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).lead_ko: 닉스(Nyx) QV 스테이션의 창고 구역에서 찾을 수 있는 거래 가능한 유물 조각 (손상 없는 상태).
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).desc_ko: 출처를 알 수 없고 정체불명의 재질로 된 큰 유물 조각. 부서지긴 했지만 상태는 손상 없는 것으로 봅니다. 은은하게 초록빛을 내는 정교한 조각이 새겨져 있고, 금색 금속 띠가 둘러져 있습니다.

MG Scrip.title: MG Scrip
MG Scrip.subtitle: Currency
MG Scrip.lead: MG Scrip is a scrip currency in Star Citizen awarded by the Mercenary Guild for completing their contracts. MG Scrip can be traded for Wikelo Favors , which can in turn be traded for items at any Wikelo Emporium station.
MG Scrip.desc: Issued by the Mercenary Guild, this scrip guarantees the bearer goods in trade at authorized locations as outlined in the guild's bylaws and statutes 202C-05A. Not legal tender.
MG Scrip.lead_ko: 용병 길드(Mercenary Guild) 계약을 완료하면 받는 스크립 화폐. 위켈로 호의(Wikelo Favor)로 바꿀 수 있습니다.
MG Scrip.desc_ko: 용병 길드가 발행한 스크립으로, 길드 규약 202C-05A에 정한 공인 장소에서 소지자에게 물품 교환을 보장합니다. 법정 화폐가 아닙니다.

MISC Fortune Wikelo Special.title: Fortune
MISC Fortune Wikelo Special.subtitle: Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern
MISC Fortune Wikelo Special.lead: The Fortune is a salvage ship developed by Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern . It represents a significant advancement in industrial operations, offering a streamlined and efficient vessel tailored for salvage operations. Designed for individual operators, this innovative ship features a groundbreaking external cargo loader that simplifies the salvaging process for solo crews. It is the ideal choice for those seeking to enhance their operational capabilities.

MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.title: Starlancer MAX
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.lead: The Starlancer MAX is a medium freighter developed by Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern . It is designed specifically for deep space operations and features two cargo holds. This vessel enables freelance operators and commercial enterprises to explore further into the 'verse, pushing beyond established boundaries to support the expansion of Humanity's frontiers.
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.key: MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: MISC의 중형 화물선. 심우주 작전용으로 설계됐고 화물칸이 두 곳입니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

Metamaterial Test.title: Metamaterial Test
Metamaterial Test.subtitle: Misc item
Metamaterial Test.lead: Metamaterial Test #146 is a craftable item used in Wikelo contracts, specifically the L-22 Alpha Wolf .
Metamaterial Test.desc: This is a test for new metamaterial with special design by Wikelo. It will be light and strong but maybe not! Good to test.
Metamaterial Test.lead_ko: 위켈로 계약(특히 L-22 Alpha Wolf)에 쓰이는 제작 아이템 Metamaterial Test #146.
Metamaterial Test.desc_ko: 위켈로 특별 설계 새 메타물질 시험. 가볍고 튼튼할 것, 아닐 수도! 시험하기 좋음.

Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.title: Guardian MX
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.lead: The Guardian MX is a variant of the Guardian heavy fighter series of ships developed by Mirai . By enhancing the Guardian fighter framework with a broader array of offensive capabilities, the MX is equipped with increased firepower and armor, making it well-suited for overpowering adversaries. Although it lacks the agility of the original Guardian, this heavy fighter still demonstrates greater maneuverability compared to numerous other vessels within its category.
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.key: Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Mirai Guardian 중전투기 계열의 화력 강화형 MX. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.title: Guardian QI
Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.lead: The Guardian QI is an interdictor variant of the Guardian manufactured by Mirai . The Guardian exemplifies resilience and proficiency in combat scenarios, demonstrating exceptional capability even when confronting adversaries of significantly larger size. The QI enhances this effectiveness by incorporating a quantum dampener, which mitigates the advantage of faster vessels, thereby leveling the playing field against more agile opponents. This feature equips the Guardian to be well-prepared for a diverse range of missions.
Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.lead_ko: Mirai Guardian의 차단(인터딕터)형 QI. 위켈로 'Special' 버전.

Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.title: Guardian
Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.lead: The Guardian is a small Heavy Fighter developed by Mirai . Following its success in the snub market with the highly specialized Fury , Mirai expands its ambitions by entering the heavyweight space-combat arena. The Guardian exemplifies Mirai's commitment to performance-driven ship design, amplifying this philosophy to create a formidable brawler. This vessel is engineered to confront a wide array of threats, regardless of their scale or intensity.
Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Mirai의 소형 중전투기. 스넙 전투기 Fury의 성공 뒤 Mirai가 중량급 우주전에 내놓은 기체입니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.title: Pulse
Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.lead: The Pulse is a compact grav-cycle by Mirai . An open-canopy bike with a form-fitting silhouette and an intelligent integrated combat system, the Mirai Pulse is a fast, nimble vehicle for all planetary needs. The standard version showcases exceptional combat capabilities. Equipped with a Size 2 laser repeater mounted on the nose from the factory, engaging enemies directly has never been more thrilling. Performing jousting, hit-and-run, or bank-and-flank tactics is now more effortless than in the past.
Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.lead_ko: Mirai의 소형 그래브 사이클(호버 바이크). 개방형 캐노피와 지능형 통합 전투 시스템을 갖춘 빠르고 날렵한 지상 이동 수단입니다. 위켈로 'Special' 버전.

Monde Arms.title: Monde Arms
Monde Arms.subtitle: Arm armor
Monde Arms.lead: The Monde Arms is the arms of the Monde armor set, manufactured by Kilgore and Poole .
Monde Arms.desc: From the masterwork designers of Kilgore & Poole comes the Monde heavy armor. Effortlessly integrating triple-laminate plating with the latest in defensive technology, this armor provides battle-ready protection with a next-class comfort system and specialized flex-point joints.
Monde Arms.lead_ko: Kilgore and Poole의 Monde 방어구 세트 중 팔 부위.
Monde Arms.desc_ko: Kilgore & Poole의 장인 디자이너들이 만든 Monde 중장갑 방어구. 3중 적층 장갑판과 최신 방어 기술을 매끄럽게 결합해, 차세대 착용감 시스템과 특수 유연 관절로 전투에 바로 나설 수 있는 보호력을 제공합니다.

Monde Arms Crimson Camo.title: Monde Arms Crimson Camo
Monde Arms Crimson Camo.subtitle: Arm armor
Monde Arms Crimson Camo.lead: The Monde Arms Crimson Camo is the arms of the Monde armor set, manufactured by Kilgore and Poole .
Monde Arms Crimson Camo.desc: tem Type: Heavy Armor From the masterwork designers of Kilgore & Poole comes the Monde heavy armor. Effortlessly integrating triple-laminate plating with the latest in defensive technology, this armor provides battle-ready protection with a next-class comfort system and specialized flex-point joints. RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.title: Polaris
RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.lead: The Polaris is a corvette-class capital ship developed by Roberts Space Industries (RSI) for the United Empire of Earth Navy (UEEN). Tundra Kopion Horn.subtitle: Misc item
Tundra Kopion Horn.lead: Tundra Kopion Horn are horns from the Tundra Kopion , found in the grasslands immediately adjacent to the snow-covered lowlands of microTech .
Tundra Kopion Horn.desc: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. When properly processed, it can be used to aid in bone regeneration with a far greater rate of success than lab-grown materials. This application has made it a valuable commodity.
Tundra Kopion Horn.lead_ko: 마이크로텍(microTech)의 눈 덮인 저지대 바로 옆 초원에 사는 툰드라 코피온의 뿔.
Tundra Kopion Horn.desc_ko: 코피온의 뿔은 뼈와 천연 탄소 나노물질이 독특하게 결합된 것입니다. 제대로 가공하면 실험실에서 기른 재료보다 훨씬 높은 성공률로 뼈 재생을 도울 수 있어, 귀한 원자재로 취급됩니다.

Tungsten.title: Tungsten
Tungsten.subtitle: Metal
Tungsten.lead: Tungsten is a metal refined from tungsten ore.
Tungsten.desc: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).title: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine)
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).subtitle: Misc item
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).lead: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine) is a pristine medal from the United Empire of Earth Marines 6th platoon.
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).desc: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The excellent appearance of the ribbon and etchings on the observe have left this medal in pristine condition.
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).lead_ko: UEE 해병대 제6소대의 메달 (손상 없는 상태).
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).desc_ko: 뛰어난 공을 세운 UEE 해병대 제6소대원에게 주는 메달. 이름난 제6소대 '팬텀'은 제2차 테바린 전쟁 작전, 반두르 전선, 레이어 III에서 아웃사이더에게 인질로 잡힌 UEE 조사팀 구출 등으로 이 영예를 여러 번 받았습니다. 리본과 앞면 새김 상태가 훌륭해 손상 없는 상태로 남아 있습니다.

Vanduul Metal.title: Vanduul Metal
Vanduul Metal.subtitle: Misc item
Vanduul Metal.lead: The Vanduul Metal is a crafting item found on Vanduul (pilot) bodies in Nyx.
Vanduul Metal.desc: A piece of metal of Vanduul origin.
Vanduul Metal.lead_ko: 닉스(Nyx)의 반두르(Vanduul) 조종사 시체에서 얻는 제작 재료.

Vanduul Plating.title: Vanduul Plating
Vanduul Plating.subtitle: Misc item
Vanduul Plating.lead: The Vanduul Plating is a crafting item found on Vanduul (pilot) bodies in Nyx.
Vanduul Plating.desc: A piece of plating typically worn by Vanduul as armor.
Vanduul Plating.lead_ko: 닉스(Nyx)의 반두르(Vanduul) 조종사 시체에서 얻는 제작 재료. 반두르가 갑옷으로 걸치는 장갑판입니다.

Vendetta \"Snow Camo\" HMG.title: Vendetta "Snow Camo" HMG
Vendetta \"Snow Camo\" HMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
Vendetta \"Snow Camo\" HMG.lead: The Vendetta "Snow Camo" HMG is the Snow Camo edition of the Vendetta HMG , a belt-fed HMG manufactured by Apocalypse Arms , finished with a white digital camo pattern suited to frozen environments.
Vendetta \"Snow Camo\" HMG.desc: Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance. Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.
Vendetta \"Snow Camo\" HMG.lead_ko: Apocalypse Arms의 탄띠 급탄식 중기관총 Vendetta의 설상 위장 에디션.
Vendetta \"Snow Camo\" HMG.desc_ko: 중형 엑소슈트 없이는 쓸 수 없을 만큼 큰 Apocalypse Arms의 Vendetta는 탄띠 급탄식 살상 도구입니다. 정확도가 부족한 대신 높은 연사력으로 목표 지역을 완전히 뒤덮어 전장을 장악합니다. 흰색 디지털 위장 무늬의 Snow Camo 에디션은 얼어붙은 환경에서 사냥감을 쫓기에 제격입니다.

Vendetta HMG.title: Vendetta HMG
Vendetta HMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
Vendetta HMG.lead: The Vendetta HMG is a belt-fed HMG manufactured by Apocalypse Arms , too large to fire without a heavy exo-suit and trading accuracy for a rate of fire that saturates a target area.
Vendetta HMG.desc: Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance.
Vendetta HMG.lead_ko: Apocalypse Arms의 탄띠 급탄식 중기관총. 중형 엑소슈트 없이는 쏠 수 없을 만큼 크고, 정확도 대신 높은 연사력으로 지역을 제압합니다.
Vendetta HMG.desc_ko: 중형 엑소슈트 없이는 쓸 수 없을 만큼 큰 Apocalypse Arms의 Vendetta는 탄띠 급탄식 살상 도구입니다. 정확도가 부족한 대신 높은 연사력으로 목표 지역을 완전히 뒤덮어 전장을 장악합니다.

Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap).title: Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap)
Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap).subtitle: Magazine
Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap).lead: The Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap) is a thousand-round magazine for the Vendetta HMG , manufactured by Apocalypse Arms .
Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap).desc: This magazine for the Apocalypse Arms Vendetta HMG comes pre-loaded with a thousand rounds.
Vendetta HMG Magazine (1000 Cap).desc_ko: Apocalypse Arms Vendetta 중기관총용 탄창으로, 1,000발이 장전된 상태로 제공됩니다.

Warden Backpack Crimson Camo.title: Warden Backpack Crimson Camo
Warden Backpack Crimson Camo.subtitle: Backpack
Warden Backpack Crimson Camo.lead: The Warden Backpack Crimson Camo is a backpack manufactured by Virgil Ltd .
Warden Backpack Crimson Camo.desc: This hard backpack from Virgil, Ltd. makes travel easy. Whether you need a place to carry your weapons or you've decided to bring some extra rations along for a long journey, this backpack was designed to handle any occasion. The interior features a generous, closeable pocket to keep your small items from falling out of place. This edition features a bold red digital camo pattern.
Warden Backpack Crimson Camo.desc_ko: Virgil Ltd의 하드 배낭으로 여행이 편해집니다. 무기를 넣을 곳이 필요하든 긴 여정에 비상식량을 더 챙기든, 어떤 상황에도 대응하도록 설계했습니다. 안쪽에는 작은 물건이 빠지지 않게 닫을 수 있는 넉넉한 주머니가 있습니다. 이 에디션은 대담한 빨간 디지털 위장 무늬가 특징입니다.

Warden Backpack Monde.title: Warden Backpack Monde
Warden Backpack Monde.subtitle: Backpack
Warden Backpack Monde.lead: The Warden Backpack Monde is a backpack manufactured by Virgil Ltd .
Warden Backpack Monde.desc: This hard backpack from Virgil, Ltd. makes travel easy. Whether you need a place to carry your weapons or you've decided to bring some extra rations along for a long journey, this backpack was designed to handle any occasion. The interior features a generous, closeable pocket to keep your small items from falling out of place. The Monde edition features a dark metal finish.
Warden Backpack Monde.desc_ko: Virgil Ltd의 하드 배낭으로 여행이 편해집니다. 무기를 넣을 곳이 필요하든 긴 여정에 비상식량을 더 챙기든, 어떤 상황에도 대응하도록 설계했습니다. 안쪽에는 작은 물건이 빠지지 않게 닫을 수 있는 넉넉한 주머니가 있습니다. Monde 에디션은 어두운 금속 마감입니다.

Wikelo Favor.title: Wikelo Favor
Wikelo Favor.subtitle: Misc item
Wikelo Favor.lead: Wikelo Favor is a currency item that can be earned by completing contracts offered by Wikelo and exchanged for weapons , armor and other items at any of the Wikelo Emporium stations.
Wikelo Favor.desc: A system brought over from the Banu Protectorate, favors are a form of currency given out by artisans and soulis to acknowledge work done in the past. These favors indicate successful completion of work done for Wikelo and can be exchanged for his goods and services.

Wikelo Favor.lead_ko: 위켈로 계약을 완료해 얻는 화폐 아이템. 위켈로 엠포리엄에서 무기·방어구 등과 교환할 수 있습니다.
Wikelo Favor.desc_ko: 바누 프로텍토라트에서 들여온 제도로, 호의(Favor)는 장인과 소울리가 지난 일을 인정해 주는 일종의 화폐입니다. 위켈로를 위한 일을 무사히 마쳤다는 증표이며, 그의 물건과 서비스로 바꿀 수 있습니다.

Yormandi Eye.title: Yormandi Eye
Yormandi Eye.subtitle: Misc item
Yormandi Eye.lead: Yormandi Eye is one of two eyes harvested from a Yormandi downed in Site B of the Onyx Facilities .
Yormandi Eye.desc: Able to thrive in a wide variety of environments, the yormandi has a robust immune system that responds to unknown pathogens at incredible speed. Its eyes contain antibodies that are much sought-after by medical researchers.
Yormandi Eye.lead_ko: 오닉스 시설 Site B에서 쓰러뜨린 요르만디(Yormandi)에게서 얻는 두 눈 중 하나.
Yormandi Eye.desc_ko: 다양한 환경에서 잘 사는 요르만디는 처음 보는 병원체에 놀라운 속도로 반응하는 강한 면역 체계를 가졌습니다. 눈에는 의학 연구자들이 탐내는 항체가 들어 있습니다.

Yormandi Tongue.title: Yormandi Tongue
Yormandi Tongue.subtitle: Misc item
Yormandi Tongue.lead: Yormandi Tongue is a tongue harvested from a Yormandi downed in Site B of the Onyx Facilities .
Yormandi Tongue.desc: The yormandi uses its sensitive tongue to taste its surroundings and detect prey from great distances. Renowned for its complex, subtle flavor, the tip of this organ is sought after by culinary enthusiasts throughout the Empire.
Yormandi Tongue.lead_ko: 오닉스 시설 Site B에서 쓰러뜨린 요르만디(Yormandi)에게서 얻는 혀.
Yormandi Tongue.desc_ko: 요르만디는 예민한 혀로 주변의 맛을 보고 멀리 있는 먹이를 알아챕니다. 복잡하고 미묘한 맛으로 유명해, 이 혀끝은 제국 전역의 미식가들이 찾습니다.

Zenith \"Snow Camo\" Laser Sniper Rifle.title: Zenith "Snow Camo" Laser Sniper Rifle
Zenith \"Snow Camo\" Laser Sniper Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Zenith \"Snow Camo\" Laser Sniper Rifle.lead: The Zenith "Snow Camo" Laser Sniper Rifle is a upcoming energy laser sniper rifle manufactured by Verified Offworld Laser Technologies .
Zenith \"Snow Camo\" Laser Sniper Rifle.desc: The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat. Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.
Zenith \"Snow Camo\" Laser Sniper Rifle.lead_ko: VOLT의 에너지 레이저 저격소총 Zenith (설상 위장 에디션).
Zenith \"Snow Camo\" Laser Sniper Rifle.desc_ko: VOLT의 Zenith 레이저 저격소총은 저에너지 탄을 빠르게 연사하거나, 자동 충전을 기다려 훨씬 강력한 에너지탄을 쏠 수 있어 전장에서 유연하게 운용할 수 있습니다. 강력한 탄은 소음과 열도 훨씬 많이 냅니다. 흰색 디지털 위장 무늬의 Snow Camo 에디션은 얼어붙은 환경에서 사냥감을 쫓기에 제격입니다.

Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle.title: Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle.lead: The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle is a energy laser sniper rifle manufactured by Verified Offworld Laser Technologies .
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle.lead_ko: VOLT(Verified Offworld Laser Technologies)의 에너지 레이저 저격소총.

Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.title: Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Cap)
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.subtitle: Magazine
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.lead: Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Cap) is a battery magazine for the Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle , holding the energy that powers its shots, manufactured by Verified Offworld Laser Technologies .
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.desc: This battery for the Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle holds enough energy for 22 shots.
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.key: Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Cap)
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.lead_ko: Zenith 레이저 저격소총의 사격 에너지를 담은 배터리 탄창 (VOLT).
Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle Battery (22 Ca.desc_ko: Zenith 레이저 저격소총용 배터리로, 22발을 쏠 에너지가 담겨 있습니다.
